newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht up offshore, steady in local markets.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht up offshore, steady in local markets.

text.p: The Thai baht rose further against the dollar in offshore markets, but stayed steady in the local market amid quiet trade, dealers said.

The baht was quoted at 25.080/25.180 to the dollar for the trade among offshore players compared with 25.150/25.350 in early morning. On the local market, the baht traded around 25.70/25.75 against 25.65/25.75 in late morning, dealers said.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.71 per dollar compared with 25.78 on Monday.
The foreign exchange and money markets were closed on Tuesday for a Buddhist holiday.
